```{r rawScatterWebGL, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(yaml)

# ============================================================
# 1. COLOR PALETTE ASSIGNMENT
# ============================================================
all_unique_labels  <- sort(unique(raw_data$label))
set.seed(42)
transaction_colors <- setNames(choose_palette(length(all_unique_labels)), all_unique_labels)

# ============================================================
# 2. AGGREGATE & SAMPLE DATA
# ============================================================
scatter_data <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(app_name, run_id) %>%
  sample_n(size = min(n(), 20000)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label          = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels),
    formatted_time = format(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  )

subtitle_text <- paste(sort(unique(scatter_data$run_id)), collapse = " vs ")

# ============================================================
# 3. BUILD GGPLOT
# ============================================================
scatter_plot <- ggplot(
  scatter_data,
  aes(
    x    = timestamp,
    y    = elapsed,
    fill = label,
    text = paste0(
      "Business Flow: ",   thread_group,
      "\nRun ID: ",        run_id,
      "\nTransaction: ",   label,
      "\nApplication: ",   app_name, 
      "\nTime: ",          formatted_time,
      "\nResponse Time: ", round(elapsed, 0), " ms"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "#222222", stroke = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transaction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Timeline Log",
    y = "Response Time (ms)",
    fill = "Label"
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ run_id, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right", 
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    strip.text.x     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", color = NA),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Consolas", size = 10),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 10),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(r = 20))
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. CONVERT TO PLOTLY + WebGL
# ============================================================
pl <- ggplotly(scatter_plot, tooltip = "text", height = 550) %>%
  toWebGL()

# ============================================================
# 5. LAYOUT CONFIG
# ============================================================
layout_config <- list(
  showlegend = TRUE,
  margin     = list(l = 120, r = 40, b = 80, t = 80),
  dragmode   = FALSE,
  hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
  height     = 550,
  title      = list(
    text    = paste0(
      "<b>Response Time Scatter</b>",
      "<br><sup>Runs: ", subtitle_text, "</sup>"
    ),
    x       = 0,
    xanchor = "left",
    font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
  )
)

for (i in 1:10) {
  x_name <- if (i == 1) "xaxis" else paste0("xaxis", i)
  y_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)

  if (i == 1) {
    layout_config[[x_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
    layout_config[[y_name]]$fixedrange <- TRUE
    layout_config[[y_name]]$automargin <- TRUE
  } else {
    layout_config[[x_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
    layout_config[[y_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE, automargin = TRUE)
  }
}

pl <- do.call(layout, c(list(pl), layout_config)) %>%
  plotly::config(
    responsive     = TRUE,
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    toImageButtonOptions = list(
      format   = "png",
      filename = paste0("Raw_Scatter_Combined_", Sys.Date()),
      height   = 550,
      width    = 1400
    ),
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c(
      "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
      "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
    )
  )

  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
```
